title: TRL v1.18 makes AsyncGRPOTrainer stable: generation and training run at once on separate GPUs
summary: TRL 1.18 promotes AsyncGRPOTrainer to stable. A rollout worker streams completions from a plain vllm serve while the trainer pulls from a queue and pushes new weights over NCCL, with tree packing so a shared prompt is forwarded once.

appearances.title: TRL AsyncGRPOTrainer tree attention now supports linear-attention models, up to 3.46x faster
appearances.summary: Tree attention in TRL's AsyncGRPOTrainer now works with linear-attention (FLA) models. The shared prompt prefix is processed once and its final recurrent state is passed to each continuation so branches run in parallel, with gradients summed back into the prefix in the backward pass. The author reports up to a 3.46x speedup. The change modifies two state-scan kernels from FLA's chunked Triton impl
